rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent object in all four views, so the basic massing is legible and not visibly self-colliding. However, it is mostly a compact extruded/stepped prism with little public void, court, or meaningful undercut at the verified access edge. For neighborhood living, the brief calls for an active ground threshold and one clear public void or terrace; this form instead behaves like a sealed compact object with limited street response. The silhouette is acceptable but not especially resolved as a capacity-bearing section, and the upper shaping does not produce a convincing program section or daylight/terrace logic. Because the visible mass can plausibly support mixed-use neighborhood living only weakly, program_fit_hard_pass fails.
